text:
Alex K.: heads up — getting a big alert storm from embedder-v2 in us-east-1, PD is spamming oncall groups :rotating_light:
Maria S.: seeing it too, lots of 5xx and retry spikes in the logs
Chris B.: looks like a backend storage throttling event, increasing retries -> amplification
Tilly (oncall): I’m on it. Can we squelch noisy low-priority alerts that are drowning the page?
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0394 by Alex K. (auto) — paging enabled
Alex K.: immediate mitigation plan: 1) set temporary rate-limit on PD for embedder errors 2) dedupe identical alerts by request_hash 3) mute non-customer-impact alerts for 20m
Maria S.: +1. I’ll create a temp dedupe rule in the alert manager. Patch:
```
# alertmanager patch (temporary)
route:
  receiver: 'pagerduty'
  group_labels: ['service','region','request_hash']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 30m
  repeat_interval: 4h
```
Chris B.: FYI, request_hash exists in logs — grouping by that should collapse retries from same origin
Tilly (oncall): applying a short-term squelch now for severity=warning from embedder-v2 (20m). notifying PD to reduce noise.
Alex K.: PD change: set max_alerts_per_minute=3 for embedder-v2 key in PD rules. Doing curl to ops-api:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/ratelimit -d '{"service":"embedder-v2","ppm":3}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
Maria S.: created dashboard panel for error_rate by customer_id and host — link: https://grafana.redwood/d/XY/embedder-spike?orgId=1
Chris B.: rolling back the db client bump that started aggressive retry behavior — trigger in flight
Tilly (oncall): PD volume dropped ~70% after squelch + rate-limit :thumbsup: — still watching for customer 42, flagged in dashboard
Alex K.: customer-impact? any reports from downstream customers?
Maria S.: no active customer tickets yet, but a couple of live eval jobs failed. marking as "potential" impact. tagging incident INC-2026-0394 with customer-impact:potential
Tilly (oncall): logging actions for handoff: squelch applied, dedupe rule pushed, PD rate limit set, rollback in progress. leaving oncall to Chris for verification — I’m handing off in 10m.
Chris B.: will verify metrics over next 30m and validate errors trend down. will also add temporary alert transform to drop identical stack traces (low value noise).
ops-runbooks-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/embedder#throttling — recommended followups: increase storage IOPS, implement per-customer throttle, tune retries
Alex K.: follow-ups (tickets): ENGSRE-4321 add per-customer grouping and PD key, ENGSRE-4322 permanent dedupe rules + runbook update, ENGSRE-4323 autoscale embedder pool on retry surge
Maria S.: agree — also add eval-based regression test to catch client retry changes before deploys
Tilly (oncall): handoff done. leaving thread pinned. If anything spikes ping me and @pagerduty oncall. :white_check_mark: 
Chris B.: last check — error-rate trending back to baseline, rollback completed. will keep postmortem notes in INC-2026-0394 doc.
Alex K.: thanks everyone. post-incident next steps: 1) review alert thresholds (error-rate threshold bump from 1%->5% is temporary, revert with per-customer filters) 2) design grouping key by customer_id+region 3) add histogram panels for retry bursts 4) schedule 30m follow-up with SRE and infra tomorrow 0900 PT
Maria S.: adding items to backlog and assigning owners. will follow up with a short playbook PR for temporary squelch and rate-limit knobs.
Tilly (oncall): closing active paging window at 1912345930 — leaving monitoring live for 2h and will reopen if necessary. 
Alex K.: nice job team, we avoided hard customer impact and cleaned up noise. will file postmortem in 24h with details and signal changes. :sparkles:
